## 2. Production Systems & Architecture Breakdown

### System 1: Enterprise Healthcare Order & Patient Management Platform
- **Role**: Core Backend Engineer
- **Environment**: Production (Dev, Stage, Prod) on AWS
- **Runtime & Stack**: Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Apache Kafka, MySQL, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), React, Docker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions
- **Scale**: Serving 100+ healthcare practices, agencies, and medical device manufacturers; processing 10,000+ orders and clinical invoices.
- **Key Contributions & Metrics**:
  - Designed and maintained 40+ REST APIs managing orders, invoices, payments, dynamic pricing, commissions, and immutable audit logs.
  - Implemented stateless JWT authentication and strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) in Spring Security to safeguard sensitive patient data under HIPAA-aligned constraints.
  - Built Apache Kafka event streaming pipelines for real-time asynchronous background task processing.
  - Designed distributed job locking mechanisms to eliminate duplicate cron and event execution across distributed cloud instances.
  - Automated recurring Stripe billing and settlement workflows using Quartz schedulers, reducing manual operational time by 40%.
  - Integrated real-time notifications via WebSockets and automated PDF/Excel invoice and clinical report generation using Apache PDFBox and Apache POI.
  - Automated document completeness checks by integrating LLM-assisted verification for Electronic Health Records (EHR).
  - Maintained 99.9% AWS production uptime through continuous health checks, Jenkins CI/CD, and repository modernization from Apache Subversion (SVN) to Git/GitHub.

### System 2: KabilHire — Recruitment Platform & Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
- **Role**: Backend & Performance Engineer
- **Runtime & Stack**: Java 21, Spring Boot 4, PostgreSQL, Redis, React 19, TanStack Query, Playwright test harness
- **Problem**: Per-applicant N+1 interview and candidate status queries choked database connections during high-traffic hiring cycles; offset-based pagination degraded response times on deep result sets; unconstrained Kafka consumer timeouts caused broker stalls.
- **Key Architectural Solutions & Measured Outcomes**:
  - Replaced per-applicant N+1 relational lookups with a single batched `JOIN FETCH` query with composite database indexing.
  - Transitioned the search API from offset pagination to keyset cursor pagination (`(created_at, id) < (:cursor_created_at, :cursor_id)`).
  - Implemented Redis caching for candidate filter combination counts with event-driven cache invalidation on candidate state mutation.
  - Bounded Kafka client socket and request timeouts, adding message throughput caps to protect background consumers from stalling.
  - Measured and verified improvements using a 15-journey Playwright network testing harness:
    - **API Requests**: Cut by 64% (from 121 down to 44 requests).
    - **Network Payload**: Cut by 60% (from 541 KB down to 216 KB).
    - **Database Roundtrips**: N+1 per applicant eliminated completely.

### System 3: Job Scraper — Multi-Source Aggregator Engine
- **Role**: Sole Backend & Pipeline Engineer
- **Runtime & Stack**: Python, Playwright (Headless Browsers), Spring Boot, PostgreSQL
- **Delivery Timeline**: Delivered end-to-end in under 4 weeks.
- **Architecture**:
  - Built automated headless collectors for Indeed, LinkedIn, and Naukri with dynamic anti-detection measures, rate throttling, and freshness gates.
  - Designed a 4-layer deduplication engine: URL canonicalization, company-title hash normalization, geographic clustering, and description fuzzy similarity.
  - Secure integration with Spring Boot through API-key authenticated batch ingestion endpoints and database cron triggers.
  - Built a Super Admin dashboard for review, manual trigger overrides, and scraping telemetry.

### System 4: Skillroom — Prompt Intelligence Engine (Open Source)
- **Role**: Author & Maintainer
- **License**: MIT (Public Repository on GitHub)
- **Stack**: Markdown, Agent Prompt Engineering, MCP Skill Format
- **Description**: An open-source Claude Agent Skill that accepts raw, underspecified user prompts and refactors them into production-ready prompts using intent classification, domain scaffolding, few-shot demonstration injection, and an automated 0–100 quality scorecard.

### System 5: Lab Automation Tool
- **Role**: Full-Stack Developer
- **Stack**: Angular 17, PrimeNG, Spring Boot, MySQL
- **Description**: Digitized paper-based laboratory specimen tracking and diagnostic workflows into a secure, auditable web application.
